preconditions.name: arm1_summaries_supra_floor_spread
preconditions.description: ARM_1 live in-arm cand_world_summaries cross-candidate spread clears the floor (the route input must carry range). FLOOR precondition: met when measured >= threshold.

preconditions.name: arm1_e2wf_source_active
preconditions.description: ARM_1 _candidate_world_summaries returned non-None (e2_world_forward source active). FLOOR precondition: met when 1 - summaries_none_frac >= threshold.

routing.cause_iii_routing_not_wired_in_arm: routing config off / wrong source in the arm agent -- re-check _make_agent wiring
routing.cause_iii_summaries_none_e2wf_source_ina: e2_world_forward source returned None (e2 / current latent unavailable) -- check _candidate_world_summaries preconditions
routing.cause_i_live_summary_recollapse: DOMINANT HYPOTHESIS: in-arm cand_world_summaries collapse at the live tick despite e2_world_forward source -- e2 under-trained or monostrategy at select
routing.cause_ii_project_channel_range_collapse: summaries carry spread but the SVD projection flattens it -- re-examine project_channel_range
routing.cause_iv_applied_zero_despite_upstream_o: upstream OK but e3 selector records 0 -- deeper wiring (route fold / range floor) in e3.select
routing.no_collapse_reproduced: the 569g symptom did NOT reproduce -- re-examine 569g harness vs this one
routing.diagnostic_insufficient_ticks: too few measurement ticks collected -- raise P1 budget or measure cap
